Preseason Week 2 fantasy football takeaways:

Quarterback:
-Shedeur looked good! INT was a little behind but idk, also hit the dude in the hands. Seemed to get through progressions v well when given the benefit of the clean pocket. Conspiracy Ian believes the front office is the only reason Deshaun Watson is starting. Looking forward to watching Taylen Green next week
-Caleb Williams barely missed Colston Loveland down the seam so we must assume he'll be a bust/trash QB
-Let's start Fernando Mendoza in Week 1 and see what happens
-Just the preseason but it'd be a lot cooler if we had seen Cam Ward do something good over the last two weeks (did have a fun extended play throw to Helm that he should've kept his feet inbounds on) 
-Jack Strand is fun. Saw someone call him "Temu Josh Allen" which gave me a good chuckle. Still: Maybe not ideal that an undrafted rookie out of D-2 Minnesota State-Moorhead is the most positive story from the Tua-Penix QB battle? Is that fair to say?
-Helluva game Joe Milton!
-The Athan Kaliakmanis film was absolutely electric
-Throw of the week: Stetson Bennett layering it between like three dudes on 4th and 1

Running back:
-RJ Harvey clear RB2 and caught a nice TD on a wheel. His path to making the faders (me) look very dumb is 50+ receptions
-Steelers continuing to look like a 50/50 split
-Keaton Mitchell also caught a wheel that was overturned. I believe in the vision. But the Chargers o-line injuries are also already starting
-Woody Marks pretty great RB4 pick with potential for split to be more 60/40 than 80/20 + evidence HOU is comfortable giving him a workhorse role if necessary
-Every draft is a great draft to draft MarShawn Lloyd
-Kaelon Black priority late-round handcuff. Looked good and Jordan James still hurt
-Mike Washington is a fantastic handcuff. Highly doubt there's any standalone value. Shoutout to the Raiders prayer circle for healing Ashton Jeanty
-Tyrone Tracy nightmare August continues with a lost fumble. Is he going to make the team? Do my friends even really like me? Questions to ponder.
-Braelon Allen fave for Breece Hall handcuff but Isaiah Davis (knee) still sidelined
-Seeing Sean Tucker enter the game after Josh Williams makes me wonder if it's a little fucked up that we thought Tucker was going to be overly problematic for Bucky Irving
-Samaje Perine locked in RB2 for Bengals, but idk, feel like CIN, DAL, KC, IND, BAL in particular likely make a call/sign a vet if disaster strikes their backfield
-That said: Malik Davis (DAL), Emmett Johnson (KC), Seth McGowan (IND), Adam Randall (BAL) the other favorites at the moment
-Jaylen Wright (lost fumble) and Ollie Gordon (ribs) split work. There are better late-round handcuffs out there
-Jarquez Hunter looked good!
-So did Will Shipley!
-Carson Steele hurdled not one but two other human beings
-Shoutout old man Ameer Abdullah still making magic happen in August

Wide receiver:
-Jaylen Waddle 66% slot rate. Was at 18% last season
-Tetairoa McMillan has played 40% of his snaps in the slot this preseason. 16% rate last season
-Homework for this week: Try to leave every fantasy draft with a Packers WR
-De'Zhaun Stribling another nice performance and coulda been bigger if held onto 30 yard TD dime from Mac Jones. The Strib Club is provocative, there's no doubt about it. Feel like WR4 status in Round 8-9 is about right. Obviously many are even higher. Good for the many
-Carnell Tate is on pace to catch 0 passes for his career
-Kyle Williams is fooking good at football
-Ja'Kobi Lane continues to look like WR3 in Baltimore. Learned lawyers (the GOAT Drew Davenport) don't really think Rashod Bateman is going to face legal punishment/suspension this season
-RIP Isaiah Williams starting Jets WR: Preseason Week 1 - Preseason Week 1. (Long way of saying Omar Cooper was running with the 1's)
-Zachariah Branch had a nice downfield catch on a big boy route but still WR4 for now
-Jalen Royals was the best backup Chiefs WR on the field
-Isaac TeSlaa continues to not get starter's rest and is one of just three WRs with 25+ preseason routes and zero receptions
-Would say Germie Bernard favorite for slot duties in 11 personnel, but also think Pittsburgh has 90+ million reasons to get both of their tight ends on the field plenty

"My emotions got the best of me, my comments weren't intending to go at any of the fans in the city, because there's been a lot of great fans that have been supporting me.
